text: Hi, I saw your ad. I'm interested in a loan for my business.
Hi! Happy to help. So I can connect you with the right advisor, how long has your business been operating?
Three years. It's a coffee shop.
Thanks. What would you use the loan for: equipment, working capital, or something else?
To open a second location. Will I get approved?
That's up to the credit team once they review your application; I can't promise an approval or quote you a rate. Last question: do you invoice under the business's name?
Thanks, Ricardo. I can book you a call with an advisor tomorrow at 10:00 AM or 4:30 PM. Which do you prefer?
Done: call tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Here's the list of documents so you have them handy.
event: Qualified prospect · call booked in your CRM
